html:
SMTO-CFG-0073 — SMTO couldn't use your custom name and logo settings

GUID: d17f2321-0d66-4e4b-ab78-b304ef8f6400
Slug: branding-configuration-invalid
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: cfg

What happened

  • SMTO's branding file, which sets the product name, tagline and logos, has a value SMTO can't safely show. SMTO kept using the previous or default name and logo instead.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open SMTO's branding file: the file named by SMTO_BRANDING_PATH, or otherwise the branding file in SMTO's main folder. Make sure the version number at the top is 1, written without quotes. SMTO only accepts version 1, written as a plain number.
  2. Check that the name, display name and tagline are each filled in on one line, and that the whole file is smaller than 64 KB. Empty or multi-line text and oversized files are refused so the page header can't break.
  3. Make every logo path start with /agent-ui/static/, /manual/static/ or /console/static/, with no website address in front. SMTO only shows logos from its own files, never from other websites.
  4. Reload the SMTO page. If you only want a different name in the app, use Settings › General › UI Preferences › Agent name instead of editing the file. SMTO notices file changes on its own, and Agent name changes the displayed name without touching the file.

What success looks like

  • After a reload, your name, tagline and logo appear in the page header and browser tab.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with a copy of your branding file, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't point logos at outside websites; SMTO will keep refusing them and showing the default logo.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Branding validation rejected the configured branding file (not an object or over 64 KiB, non-integer schema_version, empty or multi-line text, unknown fields, or an asset URL outside /agent-ui/static/, /manual/static/ or /console/static/); the loader kept the last good or default branding.

What this means

  • Branding validation rejects non-object/oversized data, invalid version/text fields or asset URLs outside its bounded same-origin static-path contract. The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.

Why this can happen

  • Branding validation rejects non-object/oversized data, invalid version/text fields or asset URLs outside its bounded same-origin static-path contract.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect safe schema fields, single-line text and the exact permitted static URL prefixes and 64 KiB input bound.

How to fix it

  • Validate the active file (SMTO_BRANDING_PATH, then the application branding.json, then the packaged agent_runtime/branding.json) against docs/branding.md: integer schema_version 1, nonempty single-line brand fields, no unknown keys, same-origin static asset paths, and at most 64 KiB. The Server log records 'Branding configuration unavailable or invalid'.
  • Use an integer schema version, nonempty single-line branding text, and same-origin static asset URLs. Keep the configuration at or below 64 KiB.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended branding object validates with allowed local assets.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.
